Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973: ss. 468 and 469 rlw s. 473 - Bar to take cognizance after lapse of the period of limitation - Commencement of period D of limitation and extension thereof purpose of computing the period of limitation u/s 468, the relevant date is the date of filing of the complaint or the date of institution of prosecution and not the date on which the Magistrate takes cognizance - In view of s. 469, period of limitation in relation E to an offence shall commence
Decision Date : 26-11-2013 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 829/2005 | Disposal Nature : Reference answered | Bench : 5 Judges
